info.title: Additions Schema
info.description: The check-run-with-simple-check-suite schema (used for the check_run webhook payload) is missing the `waiting` and `requested` status values that the sibling check-run schema (used for REST API responses) already lists, so real check_run.status="waiting" webhook deliveries fail to deserialize. See https://github.com/github/rest-api-description/issues/7003

status.description: The phase of the lifecycle that the check is currently in.
